CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, the following terms shall mean:

1. Region is North Gorontalo Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of North Gorontalo.
4. Regional House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
6. Forum for the Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence, hereinafter abbreviated as FP2ATK, is a forum established based on this Regional Regulation whose membership comes from relevant agencies and communities that care about protection from acts of violence.
7. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
8. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and organizations and/or community organizations.
9. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband, wife and their child, or father and his child, or mother and her child, or blood relatives in a direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
10. Every person is an individual or corporation.
11. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
13. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
14. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
15. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
16. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
17. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.
18. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals.
19. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
20. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field.

21. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically.

22. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter referred to as P2TP2A, is an integrated service provider institution for victims established by the Regional Government.

Article 3

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children;
b. protect Women and provide services to Women and Child Victims of Acts of Violence; and
c. empower Women and Child Victims of Acts of Violence.

Article 12

Paragraph(l) Letter a What is meant by "complaint services" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community.

Letter b What is meant by "health services" is efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.

Letter c What is meant by "counseling" is a process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, guidance techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine solutions or efforts to overcome those problems.

Letter d What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and development for humans so as to provide peace, tranquility and coolness of heart to humans by always providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trust in God and continue to carry out their obligations.

Letter e What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

Letter f What is meant by "legal aid and assistance services" is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of assisting witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that are gender sensitive.

Letter g What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" is the effort to return women and child victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation/entry point, or from the receiving area to the area of origin.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Gorontalo Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of regional regulations. So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not regulated protection measures in the Region, so institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee their implementation. Regional Regulations regulate protection measures for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in North Gorontalo Regency
